name.fr-FR: L’Année liturgique : le temps pascal, I
name.en-US: The Liturgical Year: Paschal Time, Book I
name.pt-BR: O Ano Litúrgico: Tempo pascal, I

description.fr-FR: Volume 7 de l’Année liturgique (Le temps pascal, I) : un chapitre par jour ou fête, avec les textes liturgiques en latin et en français.
description.en-US: Volume 7 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French. One chapter per day or feast, with the Latin and French of the liturgical texts. Made from the 1911 Oudin printing’s OCR; the two-column Latin and French text is separated by script and some running heads remain.
description.pt-BR: Volume 7 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com o latim e o francês dos textos litúrgicos.

sources.edition: L’Année liturgique, vol. 7, Paris-Poitiers: Librairie H. Oudin, 1911. Internet Archive scan (University of Toronto), OCR text.
sources.description: Split at detected day and feast headings; running heads and page numbers removed where recognised; the Latin and French columns, interleaved line by line in the OCR, were separated by language and set as a Latin paragraph followed by its French. The table of contents at the back is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875 and Fromage in 1916; the text was printed in 1911 (before 1931).
